tools.name: transfer_ownership
tools.description: Transfer project ownership to a new owner. User needs to provide his principal-id. Anonymous users cannot transfer or receive ownership.

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

newOwnerPrincipalId.description: The Principal ID of the new owner for the project

tools.name: deploy
tools.description:
Deploy the project to a public domain (lasts 45 minutes).
            IMPORTANT: The deploy tool only deploys the files that are on the caffeine server itself. If you want to deploy local changes, you have to push the files first to the caffeine server with the push_files tool.

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

tools.name: set_project_name
tools.description: Set the name of the project in the Caffeine API

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

name.description: The new name for the project

tools.name: get_projects

visibility.description: Whether to fetch own or public projects

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return

featured.description: Only return projects that are featured by the caffeine platform

tools.name: get_project_metadata
tools.description:
Get metadata for the current project. This includes the initalPrompt, a url to the caffeine web chat of the project and last modification information.

          IMPORTANT: Prefer this tool over get_project if the desired information is available here. This response is much smaller

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get full project details including files and the whole event log ("Initialize", "Prompt", "Deploy").

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

tools.name: pull_files
tools.description:
Pull files from Caffeine server and write them to local workspace. You don't need to check for changes with other tools, the response will give you feedback if there are any changes.

          IMPORTANT: The AI should never set this to true without explicit user confirmation. If the user agrees to overwrite the local changes, set the property to true once, and in succeeding calls to false again.

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

overwrite_local_changes.description: Whether to overwrite local changes. IMPORTANT: The AI should never set this to true without explicit user confirmation. If the user agrees to overwrite the local changes, set the property to true once, and in succeeding calls to false again.

tools.name: push_files
tools.description: Push files from workspace to Caffeine backend

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project with an initial prompt. The workspace folder must be empty.

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

initialPrompt.description: The initial prompt to create the project with

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download a project into a new folder. If the project is not owned by the user, clone must be set to true to create a copy first.

projectId.description: The ID of the project to download

workspaceFolder.description: The target folder where the project will be downloaded

clone.description: If true, creates a copy of the project before downloading. Must be true if the project is not owned by the user but it's totally fine to clone an own project if the user wants to.

tools.name: go_back_in_time
tools.description: Revert the project state to a specific event in its history

workspaceFolder.description: The root folder of the local copy of the caffeine project. The folder must contain a caffeine.json file with a projectId.

eventId.description: The ID of the event to revert to
